children: With that, Bram Meuleman has been elevated to Global Chief Planning and Intelligence Officer
Carat has appointed Sarah Stringer as Global Chief Strategy and Innovation Officer and elevated Bram Meuleman to Global Chief Planning and Intelligence Officer, the media agency reported on LinkedIn.
Stringer joins the expanded global leadership team after serving as Global Chief of Innovation at dentsu Media, where she led innovation strategy across media, creator and social ecosystems.
She has previously held leadership roles at Carat USA and Carat Australia, bringing experience across strategy, innovation and media.

Meuleman, who was previously Global Head of Strategy at Carat, has been promoted to the newly expanded Global Chief Planning and Intelligence Officer role. He has worked across global strategy assignments at Carat and previously held leadership positions at dentsu X and other agencies.
Carat said the two leaders will work alongside Global Brand President Chrissie Hanson to bring together cultural insights, innovation and data-driven planning across the agency.
Commenting on her appointment, Stringer said, “Great strategy starts with understanding people and imagining what’s next.”
Meuleman said he was stepping into the new role to strengthen strategic planning at Carat, adding, “At Carat, we’re doubling down on strategic planning.”
He also said the agency had invested in its planning tools, attention programmes and communication planning capabilities to help planners connect strategy with execution.
The leadership changes come as Carat continues to strengthen its strategy and planning capabilities, with the expanded roles bringing innovation, intelligence and planning closer together.
